name: Tab Man
description: Multi-window tab manager with auto-grouping, scheduled tab opens, per-site time budgets, home-tab toggle, and bulk reorganize.

home-toggle.description: Home Tab: go to home (or set current as home if none); if already on home, jump back to previous tab

home-back.description: Home Tab: back to most recent tab in this window

home-set.description: Home Tab: set current tab as home

regroup-by-domain.description: Regroup this window by domain (A → Z)

regroup-by-recency.description: Regroup this window by recency (newest first)

focus-search.description: Open Tab Man and focus the search box
